mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive, or the average rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% coincides with reduced corporate revenue expectations and lower equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered quarters, 60-day forward returns are positive, or the mechanism's average rank IC is below 0.04 over any 5-year window.

failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered episodes, 20-day forward returns are positive, or the average rank IC drops below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month MA AND HOUST < 1500 for 3 months
failure_condition: In at least 70% of triggered quarters, 60-day forward returns are positive, or the average rank IC is below 0.04 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month period where the federal funds rate remains below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2% signals a low-rate, high-inflation regime that erodes real yields and supports equity valuations, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of triggered quarters, 60-day forward returns are negative, or the average rank IC is below 0.04 over any 5-year window.
